title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
abstract: arXiv:2610.26659v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overl

translated_title: SpatialScout：视觉语言模型智能体能否主动探索并构建3D场景地图？
translated_abstract: 空间智能要求智能体主动获取视觉证据，并将观察结果整合为对三维世界的连贯表征。然而，空间问答任务对于模型能否通过自主探索构建准确的度量地图所提供的证据十分有限。我们提出了SpatialScout，一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体主动式物体级3D建图能力的基准。SpatialScout包含80个多样化的室内场景，涵盖3,140个目标物体。给定物体清单、RGB观测、相机标定信息和相机位姿，智能体控制相机探索每个场景，并在共享坐标系中估计物体中心位置。该任务要求智能体在有限的交互预算下协调视角选择、跨视图关联、几何估计和地图修正。评估通过物体尺度的重叠指标，同时衡量定位精度和目标覆盖率。
tldr: 提出了SpatialScout基准，用于评估视觉语言模型智能体在有限交互预算下，通过主动探索室内场景来构建物体级3D度量地图的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating VLM agents' ability to actively explore 3D indoor scenes and construct accurate object-level metric maps under bounded interaction budgets.
